verdict.rationale: Blink documents a local command set that includes cat, grep, ls and other file utilities, plus a built-in curl for file transfers. Commands run individually with redirection but explicitly without pipes, and tar is never mentioned. Missing for 10: evidence of tar, pipe support between commands, independent hands-on corroboration of local command use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run local UNIX commands like ls, grep, cat, tar, and curl directly in the app

citations.quote: cat, grep, wc, cd, setenv, ls, touch, cp, rm, ln, mv, mkdir, rmdir, df, du
curl (includes http, https, scp, sftp...), scp, sftp
You can call commands individually, or use small scripts using python or lua. There is redirection (">", "<", "&>" ...), but no pipe.
Manage and edit files from the command line, check on your network or download files.
